title: Galaxy Donates $50,000 to McGregor ISD Education Foundation
summary: Galaxy today announced a $50,000 donation to the McGregor ISD Education Foundation, supporting programs that enrich educational opportunities for students across McGregor Independent School District.
body_markdown:
*Contribution supports classroom innovation, staff development, and student opportunity*


Galaxy today announced a $50,000 donation to the McGregor ISD Education Foundation (“the Foundation”), supporting programs that enrich educational opportunities for students across McGregor Independent School District (“MISD”).


The donation will help the Foundation fund innovative classroom instruction, staff professional development and retention, and student development. It will also help the Foundation expand programs that elevate academic achievement and deepen the resources available to MISD teachers and staff.


“McGregor is a community we’re excited to be part of, and we want our involvement to begin with listening and giving back,” said Austin Storms, Co-Head of Galaxy Data Centers. “In conversations with community leaders, we saw how much pride there is in McGregor’s students and teachers, so we’re proud to support the McGregor ISD Education Foundation and the important work it does for them.”


“Galaxy’s generous contribution strengthens the very heart of our mission,” said Peyton Fisk, President of the McGregor ISD Education Foundation. “Their support allows us to expand programs that elevate academic achievement for MISD students and deepen the resources we provide for staff development and classroom innovation.”


Fisk added, “The Foundation’s role in providing additional resources and tools is more important than ever. Galaxy’s partnership helps ensure that support remains strong and accessible, giving our students every opportunity to thrive in a rapidly changing world. We are deeply grateful for Galaxy’s commitment to our students, our teachers, and our community, and we look forward to the collective impact we will make together for many years to come.”


The contribution builds on work Galaxy has done this year in Dickens County, Texas, home of its Helios Data Center Campus, including an[on-campus emergency services partnership with Total Safety](https://www.galaxy.com/newsroom/galaxy-announces-on-campus-emergency-services-partnership-with-total-safety-at-helios) and a[partnership with Communities In Schools of the South Plains](https://www.galaxy.com/newsroom/galaxy-partners-with-communities-in-schools-of-the-south-plains-to-support-students-in-dickens-county) to support students. Galaxy is committed to being a responsible partner and investing in the communities where it operates.


**About Galaxy**


Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5.7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America. The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on[www.galaxy.com](http://www.galaxy.com/) .

**About The McGregor ISD Education Foundation**


The McGregor ISD Education Foundation is in its 10th year and was founded in January 2016, with the mission to provide resources to enrich the educational opportunities available to all McGregor ISD students. It is a non-profit, charitable organization governed by a board of directors comprised of community volunteers that sets the direction for the foundation and monitors the financial and operational performance. The Foundation is committed to providing funds that support innovative classroom instruction, staff professional development and retention, and student development.


The MISD Education Foundation is exempt from federal income tax under section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code. Contributions to the Foundation are deductible in the manner and to the extent of the law.
